claim: For Kinesis Data Streams delivery to Amazon S3, data freshness defines the maximum buffering time before records are delivered. You can configure it between 300 and 900 seconds (5 to 15 minutes); the default is 300 seconds.

qualifiers.scope: per Amazon S3 delivery of a data stream

note: NOT EXAMINABLE YET (GA 2026-08-29). Compare Firehose S3 buffering of 0 to 900 seconds. | adjudicate-34: not examinable yet (S3 delivery announced 2026-08-29, see kinesis-data-streams-change-s3-delivery-2026-08)
